title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Ledger Rule — Credits Netted From a Revolving Statement Balance
content:
**Clause.** On a Ridgeline Pro Credit revolving account, the adjusted statement balance is the latest statement's balance less the netted credits, never below zero. The netted credits are set by the account's returned payments and guarantee:

| Payments returned on the account in the last 24 months | A principal's personal guarantee on file | Netted credits |
|---|---|---|
| None | Yes | Every fee reversal, fee waiver, dispute credit, tax credit and return credit posted since the statement date |
| None | No | The fee reversals and fee waivers posted since the statement date |
| One or more | Either | Nothing is netted; the statement balance stands as printed |

## Reading the ledger

- Entries posted since the statement date are the ledger entries carrying the statement period of the newest ledger entry, when that period is later than the latest statement's period; otherwise none are.
- The 24 months are whole calendar months counted back from the payment date; a returned payment is shown by a returned payment line on the account.
- Whether a guarantee is on file is shown on the account record.

## Worked cases (hypothetical: statement balance 2400.00; since the statement, a fee reversal of 10.00, a fee waiver of 39.00 and a return credit of 300.00)

| Returned payments in 24 months | Guarantee | Netted credits | Adjusted statement balance |
|---|---|---|---|
| None | On file | 349.00 | 2051.00 |
| None | Not on file | 49.00 | 2351.00 |
| One | On file | 0.00 | 2400.00 |
